content.heading: Disciplined investing for long-term wealth
content.body_text: We help families and institutions build portfolios around clear goals, careful research and an honest view of risk.

content.heading: Services built around your goals
content.intro: Three ways we work with clients, each starting with a conversation about what you want your money to do.

cards.heading: Wealth planning
cards.body_text: A written plan that connects your investments to cash flow, taxes and the milestones that matter to you.

cards.heading: Portfolio management
cards.body_text: Diversified portfolios built from research, reviewed regularly and rebalanced with discipline.

cards.heading: Retirement and estate
cards.body_text: Income planning for retirement and coordination with your attorney and accountant on estate matters.

content.heading: Research first. Risk always.
content.body_text:
Every recommendation starts with independent research and a clear statement of the risks involved. We favour diversification, low costs and patience over short-term predictions.

We report plainly on what we own, why we own it and how it has behaved, in good markets and bad.

content.heading: Ready to talk about your plan?
content.intro: Book a short introductory call. There is no obligation, and we will tell you honestly whether we are a good fit.

disclaimer: Northwind Capital is fictional. Content is placeholder copy for theme testing only.
